mechanism: Chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and dehydration may potentiate opioid-related CNS depression and increase risk of orthostatic hypotension; hydrocodone may mask compensatory tachycardia from volume depletion.
action: Monitor potassium levels, blood pressure, and CNS symptoms; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antihypertensive if opioid use is chronic or high-dose.
